dedupe_keys.name: railsys rail traffic planning and simulation software suite

description: RailSys is a commercial software suite for planning, controlling and analysing rail traffic. The 2024 release announced by RMCon International includes millimetre-precise modelling of infrastructure, expanded definitions of infrastructure conditions, automatic route search and allocation, dynamic driving outputs and energy-saving driving strategies, capture and analysis of actual operating data, an operation control centre module, an evaluation manager with boxplot outputs, interfaces following the TAF/TAP TSI, and calculation of train path usage fees with invoice generation. It is developed and sold by RMCon International and is generic, applied to rail networks anywhere. Access is by commercial licence, with offers requested through a contact form and the release notes available as a PDF download. Caveats: it is proprietary and paid, and the product page is a release announcement without technical documentation. RailSys supports rail capacity planning, timetable robustness and operational simulation, and energy optimisation of train driving. It complements OpenTrack, NeTrainSim and the other rail simulators catalogued here.
